body: Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me. **Testing project:** [test_pr_110499.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22315592/test_pr_110499.zip) Note that GIMP 3.0.4 incorrectly exports red and blue channel data in uncompressed RGB10A2 DDS, so it will look like channels are being swapped by Godot, but it's not the case. Reopening the exported DDS in GIMP will result in swapped channels too. After reopening the DDS in GIMP: Mipmaps work OK, although like in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/110257, the alpha channel will appear biased due to being less detailed than color channels. This isn't too noticeable if alpha is identical in large portions of the image (e.g. on the banded gradient here): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/042b1912-b53c-4ecc-bc17-c2d68f22cc4f But it's much more noticeable with mixed alpha levels, where each pixel has a random alpha value: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d11cba87-773e-4592-833a-1f6410b360c6
